tytul: Porcini and truffle butter: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for butter with porcini mushrooms or truffles.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Drying and cooking do not destroy the toxins of poisonous mushrooms, and only an expert can tell edible species from poisonous ones.

akapity: There is no research-based information for consumers showing that adding herbs or vegetables to butter makes a product that is safe at room temperature or in the refrigerator.
In 1993 the US FDA warned consumers not to prepare homemade spices in oil, margarine or butter for extended storage.
NCHFP’s freezing advice covers butter alone and does not mention added mushrooms or truffles: freeze only high-quality butter made from pasteurized cream.
JarAtlas has found no checked source on butter with mushrooms or truffles.
